queries:
WITH rating_averages AS (
  SELECT
    rating,
    AVG(replacement_cost) AS average_replacement_cost,
    AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS average_rental_price_per_day
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
)
SELECT
  rating,
  average_replacement_cost,
  average_rental_price_per_day,
  average_rental_price_per_day / AVG(average_rental_price_per_day) OVER () AS per_day_price_ratio
FROM rating_averages

WITH rating_averages AS (
  SELECT
    rating,
    AVG(replacement_cost) AS average_replacement_cost,
    AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(rental_duration) AS average_rental_price_per_day
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
)
SELECT
  rating,
  average_replacement_cost,
  average_rental_price_per_day,
  average_rental_price_per_day / AVG(average_rental_price_per_day) OVER () AS ratio_to_rating_average
FROM rating_averages

WITH rating_averages AS (
  SELECT
    rating,
    AVG(replacement_cost) AS average_replacement_cost,
    AVG(rental_rate) AS average_daily_rental_price
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
)
SELECT
  rating,
  average_replacement_cost,
  average_daily_rental_price,
  average_daily_rental_price / (
    SELECT AVG(average_daily_rental_price)
    FROM rating_averages
  ) AS ratio_to_average_across_ratings
FROM rating_averages

WITH rating_averages AS (
  SELECT
    f.rating,
    AVG(f.replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost,
    AVG(f.rental_rate * 1.0 / f.rental_duration) AS avg_rental_price_per_day
  FROM film AS f
  JOIN inventory AS i ON i.film_id = f.film_id
  GROUP BY f.rating
)
SELECT
  rating,
  avg_replacement_cost,
  avg_rental_price_per_day,
  avg_rental_price_per_day / (
    SELECT AVG(avg_rental_price_per_day)
    FROM rating_averages
  ) AS ratio_to_rating_average
FROM rating_averages
